description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ParameterPredicateVisitor class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.query.filter package. The tests validate the visitor's behavior in traversing query expression AST nodes (RootNode, LogicalNode, SingleComparisonNode) and producing corresponding criteria objects, including handling of logical operators and comparison types.
